compiler: g++ Debian 14.2.0-19, x86_64, no fast-math/FMA contraction

segment_parity.scope: Native lerp/ordered support bytes; original per-sample gate/obstacle/slope decisions, no samples removed; Linux only

scalar_support_regression.scope: Same ordered source cells, float32 vectors/cross, float64 scalar arithmetic, exact dictionary bytes; Linux only, not FPS

Batch evaluates immutable support points beyond an eventual early obstacle rejection; support-cache counters/FIFO contents change, battle state does not
Unsupported platform, missing binary, explicit batch disable, nonfinite/extreme/big segment inputs fall back to reference path
